title: C15 Zakernost
prompt: Low-angle shot of a tall dark stone weapon forge tower with racks of swords and spears engulfed in roaring bright orange chaos flames, its walls cracking and starting to collapse, crackling orange lightning, at the bottom two small sneaky goblin imps run away: the first imp is thin and green-skinned with long pointed ears carrying a lit torch, the second imp is fat and grey-skinned with small horns carrying a stolen sword. Background: burning smoky orange and dark red sky. Palette: crimson, burnt orange, bright yellow-orange, black, no teal. No text.

title: C18 Kradez osudu
prompt: A dark void with a swirling spiral vortex of bright orange chaos energy in the centre, long glowing orange threads of fate spiral out of the vortex and pull in many floating playing cards with plain dark backs from all directions toward its blinding white-orange core, crackling orange lightning along the threads, orange sparks. No people, no hands. Background: deep cold dark teal and black, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text, no symbols on the cards.

title: C05 Vybuch
prompt: A gigantic explosion of bright orange chaos fire bursting from the centre of the frame, swirling flame tendrils and a blinding white-yellow core, a ring-shaped shockwave tearing apart a dark castle wall in the lower part of the image, stone blocks blasted outward, crackling orange lightning inside the fireball, orange embers everywhere. No people. Background: dark red smoke. Palette: deep red, burnt orange, bright yellow, white core, black, no teal. No text.

title: C06 Boure
prompt: Wide shot of a vast flat dark plain under a gigantic churning storm of bright orange chaos clouds, dozens of jagged bright orange lightning bolts strike the ground at once, the ground cracks and glows where they hit, swirling orange dust and sparks, a tiny ruined watchtower on the horizon for scale. No people. Background: entire sky a turbulent orange and amber storm. Palette: amber, bright orange, yellow, dark brown ground, no teal. No text.

title: C09 Krize
prompt: Medium shot of a medieval town square collapsing into chaos: crooked half-timbered houses tilt and crack, a chasm of glowing bright orange chaos fire opens in the cobblestones, large glowing orange runes float in the smoke, market stalls, barrels and coins tumble into the chasm, a pale white-violet lightning bolt splits the black sky above. No people. Background: black and dark red smoky night. Palette: black, dark red, bright orange, a touch of pale violet in the lightning, no teal. No text.
